faq.question: Can I record a full online course at Birdcast?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support course modules, lesson videos, coaching frameworks, educational explainers and client education content.

faq.question: How should I prepare before a course recording?
faq.answer: Prepare a module outline, key teaching points, examples and any slides or visual references. This helps the session move faster.

faq.question: Can several lessons be recorded in one session?
faq.answer: Yes. With a clear outline, multiple lessons or modules can be recorded efficiently in one studio session.

faq.question: Is this suitable for coaches and consultants?
faq.answer: Yes. Coaches and consultants can turn frameworks, methods and expertise into professional video lessons or educational clips.

faq.question: How are the recordings delivered?
faq.answer: Finished content can be delivered through Google Drive or the agreed delivery flow, depending on the scope of the project.
